title: Recipe 40 — Channel: iMessage (host-bound, and deliberately kill-switched)

beats.label: Open the recipe
beats.cue: “The one channel that can't run in a container: chat.db and Messages.app are on this Mac or nowhere.”

beats.label: Start from a blank spec
beats.cue: live/ is scratch — nothing committed is touched by a take.

beats.label: Load the API key
beats.cue: [needs-key] Sources demos/.env for the boot beat.

beats.label: Type the recipe's spec
beats.cue: “Same channel block as every other adapter — the provider is the only line that knows this is iMessage.”

beats.label: Lint the spec
beats.cue: “Clean — the host-bound-ness is a runtime property, not a spec one.”

beats.label: Show the lowered IR
beats.cue: “Identical shape to Telegram and WhatsApp. The compiler does not special-case this one.”

beats.label: Compile the bundle — and check it
beats.cue: “--check asserts, installs, and boots: GREEN, gated at the credentials the spec declares.”

verify.note: GREEN — assertion ok; install ok; boot gated at the declared credentials gate

beats.label: Open the emitted gateway
beats.cue: “Inbound is a chat.db poll, not a webhook — there is no port to open and nothing to tunnel.”

beats.label: Boot it with nothing configured
beats.cue: “Fail-closed by construction: the daemon refuses at the first missing gate rather than half-starting against your message history.”
beats.command: env -u CREWHAUS_IMESSAGE_HOST_ENABLED -u ANTHROPIC_API_KEY -u ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN bun live/dist/daemon.ts > live/killswitch.log 2>&1

verify.note: exit 2 — `[daemon] missing required env vars: ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN or ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`; the provider gate is checked before anything touches chat.db

beats.label: Read the refusal
beats.cue: “It names the gate it stopped at. Nothing was read, nothing was sent.”

beats.label: Read the host kill switch
beats.cue: “Past that gate there's a second one the recipe documents — CREWHAUS_IMESSAGE_HOST_ENABLED=1, an explicit opt-in for the one adapter that reads your personal message history.”

groups.title: One more thing · run it on this Mac

beats.label: Boot with the opt-in set
beats.cue: [manual] “Needs Full Disk Access for the terminal and an Automation grant for Messages.app — a human clicks those.”

verify.note: macOS TCC prompts for Full Disk Access + Messages automation

beats.label: Text the Mac
beats.cue: [manual] “Send an iMessage from a phone; the poller picks it up on the next tick and replies through Messages.app.”

beats.label: Run the channel smoke
beats.cue: [needs-key] “bun run smoke:section-33-imessage drives the adapter against a fixture chat.db.”

verify.note: needs the host opt-in and an Anthropic credential

beats.label: Read what's missing
beats.cue: “The recipe is honest about the gaps: no read receipts, no typing indicators, no group threads.”
